title: OCPP Sessions (lab)
description: Per-session charging data read from TimescaleDB (meter_samples hypertable) — the product-data plane, deliberately separate from the Prometheus ops metrics on the registry dashboard. Top-down layout: fleet totals first, then the selected charge point's EVSEs (guns), then the selected session's details. Built around the first real charger: a battery-buffered dual-gun DC FlexPole whose HMI labels the guns A (connector 1) and B (connector 2). Session-scoped panels ignore the time range in SQL but plot in absolute time — if a curve looks empty, widen the range to cover the session (or use the panel's zoom-to-data). Raw samples stay raw in the store; unit normalization (kW/kWh) happens per-row in the queries.

list.name: chargepoint
list.label: charge point
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT charge_point FROM meter_samples ORDER BY 1
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT charge_point FROM meter_samples ORDER BY 1

list.name: session
list.label: session (tx)
list.definition: SELECT transaction_id AS "__value", transaction_id || '  (' || to_char(min(ts) AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Stockholm', 'Mon DD HH24:MI') || ', ' || CASE connector_id WHEN 1 THEN 'Gun A' WHEN 2 THEN 'Gun B' ELSE 'conn ' || connector_id END || ')' AS "__text" FROM meter_samples WHERE transaction_id IS NOT NULL AND charge_point = '$chargepoint' GROUP BY transaction_id, connector_id ORDER BY transaction_id DESC LIMIT 50
list.query: SELECT transaction_id AS "__value", transaction_id || '  (' || to_char(min(ts) AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Stockholm', 'Mon DD HH24:MI') || ', ' || CASE connector_id WHEN 1 THEN 'Gun A' WHEN 2 THEN 'Gun B' ELSE 'conn ' || connector_id END || ')' AS "__text" FROM meter_samples WHERE transaction_id IS NOT NULL AND charge_point = '$chargepoint' GROUP BY transaction_id, connector_id ORDER BY transaction_id DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Sessions per day
panels.description: Distinct (charge point, tx) pairs with samples on each calendar day (Europe/Stockholm), across the fleet. Rendered as category bars: the previous version bucketed to UTC midnight on a time axis, so with a short range the bucket timestamp fell outside the visible window and the panel claimed 'No sessions in range' despite data. Caveats: a tx reporting across midnight counts on each day it touches, and sim tx ids merge across CS restarts. Exact times of day are on the charge timeline below.

targets.rawSql: SELECT to_char(time_bucket('1 day', ts, 'Europe/Stockholm') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Stockholm', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "day", count(DISTINCT charge_point || ':' || transaction_id)::int AS "sessions" FROM meter_samples WHERE transaction_id IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Cars charged
panels.description: Distinct (charge point, tx) pairs with samples in the dashboard range — i.e. metered charging sessions, our best proxy for cars served. Lab caveat: tx ids come from the CS and its counter resets on restart, so sim sessions reusing an id merge into one.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(DISTINCT charge_point || ':' || transaction_id) AS "cars charged" FROM meter_samples WHERE transaction_id IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(ts)

panels.title: Charges — time of day
panels.description: Every transaction across the fleet at its actual wall-clock time — one lane per charge point, block value = tx id, from per-minute buckets of meter_samples. Complements 'Sessions per day', which only shows dates. Gaps longer than 6 minutes break a block. Lab caveat: reused tx ids merge across CS restarts.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time_bucket('1 minute', ts) AS "time", charge_point AS metric, max(transaction_id) AS value FROM meter_samples WHERE transaction_id IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Sessions
panels.description: Latest 25 transactions fleet-wide, newest first — start/end carry full date and time. kWh is the import-register span (falls back to the export register for the sim, which sends export only); avg kW is the mean of in-tx power samples; last SoC is the car's final reported value. Ignores the dashboard time range so the session picker always has context. Lab caveat: sim tx ids reset per CS restart, so a reused id merges into one long row.

targets.rawSql: SELECT transaction_id AS "tx", charge_point AS "charge point", CASE connector_id WHEN 1 THEN 'A' WHEN 2 THEN 'B' ELSE connector_id::text END AS "gun", min(ts) AS "start", max(ts) AS "end", EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (max(ts) - min(ts))) AS "duration", round((COALESCE(max(value * CASE WHEN unit = 'kWh' THEN 1 WHEN unit = 'MWh' THEN 1000 ELSE 0.001 END) FILTER (WHERE measurand = 'Energy.Active.Import.Register') - min(value * CASE WHEN unit = 'kWh' THEN 1 WHEN unit = 'MWh' THEN 1000 ELSE 0.001 END) FILTER (WHERE measurand = 'Energy.Active.Import.Register'), max(value * CASE WHEN unit = 'kWh' THEN 1 WHEN unit = 'MWh' THEN 1000 ELSE 0.001 END) FILTER (WHERE measurand LIKE 'Energy.Active.%.Register') - min(value * CASE WHEN unit = 'kWh' THEN 1 WHEN unit = 'MWh' THEN 1000 ELSE 0.001 END) FILTER (WHERE measurand LIKE 'Energy.Active.%.Register')))::numeric, 2) AS "kWh", round(avg(value * CASE WHEN unit = 'kW' THEN 1 WHEN unit = 'MW' THEN 1000 ELSE 0.001 END) FILTER (WHERE measurand = 'Power.Active.Import')::numeric, 1) AS "avg kW", round(last(value, ts) FILTER (WHERE measurand = 'SoC' AND location <> 'Body'))::int AS "last SoC %" FROM meter_samples WHERE transaction_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ORDER BY max(ts) DESC LIMIT 25

panels.title: Gun activity — when was each EVSE charging?
panels.description: Per-minute buckets of meter_samples with a transaction attached, one lane per gun; the block value is the OCPP transaction id. Gaps longer than 6 minutes break a block (the 5-minute pre-charge handshake stays bridged). A gun with no lane had no session in range. Lab caveat: the CS transaction counter resets on restart, so a reused tx id shows as one continuous state across restarts.

defaults.noValue: No sessions in range on this charge point

targets.rawSql: SELECT time_bucket('1 minute', ts) AS "time", CASE connector_id WHEN 1 THEN 'Gun A' WHEN 2 THEN 'Gun B' ELSE 'Connector ' || connector_id END AS metric, max(transaction_id) AS value FROM meter_samples WHERE charge_point = '$chargepoint' AND transaction_id IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Max simultaneous guns
panels.description: Highest number of this charge point's guns metering a transaction in the same minute, over the dashboard range. 2 ⇒ both guns charged at once; 1 ⇒ sessions never overlapped.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(max(active), 0) AS "max simultaneous guns" FROM (SELECT time_bucket('1 minute', ts) AS b, count(DISTINCT connector_id) AS active FROM meter_samples WHERE charge_point = '$chargepoint' AND transaction_id IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY 1) x

panels.title: Buffer battery SoC (grid-side view)
panels.description: Checked live: this firmware exposes no grid-side measurands over OCPP (no location='Inlet' rows — only Outlet, SoC@EV and SoC@Body), so grid draw vs car draw can't be plotted directly. What it does send is SoC at location='Body': the FlexPole's internal buffer battery, reported per gun side every ~15 min even while idle. The battery-buffered signature is visible here instead — the buffer dips while a car draws more than the grid feed, then recharges slowly afterwards.

defaults.noValue: No Body-SoC samples in range — firmware doesn't report a buffer battery

targets.rawSql: SELECT time_bucket('1 minute', ts) AS "time", CASE connector_id WHEN 1 THEN 'Buffer SoC - Gun A side' WHEN 2 THEN 'Buffer SoC - Gun B side' ELSE 'Buffer SoC - connector ' || connector_id END AS metric, avg(value) AS value FROM meter_samples WHERE charge_point = '$chargepoint' AND measurand = 'SoC' AND location = 'Body' AND $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: EVSEs in service
panels.description: Per-gun liveness and usage for $chargepoint. 'Last activity' is the newest meter sample of any kind (idle buffer-battery heartbeats included, all time); last tx, sessions and kWh respect the dashboard range and count only metered transactions. A gun that reports but shows 0 sessions is in service, just unused. Live connector status is on dashboard-dev.hydecharge.com/chargers.

defaults.noValue: No samples for this charge point

targets.rawSql: WITH act AS (SELECT connector_id, max(ts) AS last_any FROM meter_samples WHERE charge_point = '$chargepoint' GROUP BY 1), per_tx AS (SELECT connector_id, transaction_id, max(ts) AS last_ts, max(value * CASE WHEN unit = 'kWh' THEN 1 WHEN unit = 'MWh' THEN 1000 ELSE 0.001 END) FILTER (WHERE measurand = 'Energy.Active.Import.Register') - min(value * CASE WHEN unit = 'kWh' THEN 1 WHEN unit = 'MWh' THEN 1000 ELSE 0.001 END) FILTER (WHERE measurand = 'Energy.Active.Import.Register') AS kwh FROM meter_samples WHERE charge_point = '$chargepoint' AND transaction_id IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY 1, 2) SELECT CASE act.connector_id WHEN 1 THEN 'Gun A' WHEN 2 THEN 'Gun B' ELSE 'Connector ' || act.connector_id END AS "gun", act.last_any AS "last activity", last(per_tx.transaction_id, per_tx.last_ts) AS "last tx (range)", count(per_tx.transaction_id)::int AS "sessions (range)", COALESCE(round(sum(per_tx.kwh)::numeric, 2), 0) AS "kWh (range)" FROM act LEFT JOIN per_tx USING (connector_id) GROUP BY act.connector_id, act.last_any ORDER BY act.connector_id

panels.title: Gun
panels.description: Which EVSE (connector) served this transaction, mapped to the physical HMI labels: connector 1 = Gun A, connector 2 = Gun B.

targets.rawSql: SELECT max(connector_id) AS gun FROM meter_samples WHERE charge_point = '$chargepoint' AND transaction_id = $session

panels.title: Session duration
panels.description: max(ts) − min(ts) across every sample attributed to the transaction. Includes the pre-charge handshake before power flows (tx 100: plugged in 16:15, power from 16:20).

targets.rawSql: SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (max(ts) - min(ts))) AS "duration" FROM meter_samples WHERE charge_point = '$chargepoint' AND transaction_id = $session

panels.title: Energy delivered
panels.description: Register span (max − min) of Energy.Active.Import.Register within the transaction, normalized per-row from the reported unit. The register is a lifetime meter — only the in-session delta is meaningful, never the absolute value.

targets.rawSql: SELECT max(value * CASE WHEN unit = 'kWh' THEN 1 WHEN unit = 'MWh' THEN 1000 ELSE 0.001 END) - min(value * CASE WHEN unit = 'kWh' THEN 1 WHEN unit = 'MWh' THEN 1000 ELSE 0.001 END) AS "energy" FROM meter_samples WHERE charge_point = '$chargepoint' AND transaction_id = $session AND measurand = 'Energy.Active.Import.Register'

panels.title: Avg power
panels.description: Mean of the Power.Active.Import samples during the transaction (≈ register span ÷ charging time; includes the ramp-up).

targets.rawSql: SELECT avg(value * CASE WHEN unit = 'kW' THEN 1 WHEN unit = 'MW' THEN 1000 ELSE 0.001 END) AS "avg power" FROM meter_samples WHERE charge_point = '$chargepoint' AND transaction_id = $session AND measurand = 'Power.Active.Import'

panels.title: Peak power
panels.description: Highest Power.Active.Import sample in the transaction. Compare with the power panel's Offered ceiling: peak < offered means the car was the limiter.

targets.rawSql: SELECT max(value * CASE WHEN unit = 'kW' THEN 1 WHEN unit = 'MW' THEN 1000 ELSE 0.001 END) AS "peak power" FROM meter_samples WHERE charge_point = '$chargepoint' AND transaction_id = $session AND measurand = 'Power.Active.Import'

panels.title: Meter reports
panels.description: Distinct report timestamps within the transaction (each MeterValues report carries one row per measurand — tx 100: 60 reports at ~10 s cadence).

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(DISTINCT ts) AS "meter reports" FROM meter_samples WHERE charge_point = '$chargepoint' AND transaction_id = $session

panels.title: SoC start → end
panels.description: First non-zero and last SoC the EV reported (location ≠ 'Body', which is the charger's own buffer battery). Zero readings before the car announces its SoC are ignored. Empty ⇒ this firmware didn't send SoC for the session.

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(first(value, ts) FILTER (WHERE value > 0))::int AS "SoC start", round(last(value, ts))::int AS "SoC end" FROM meter_samples WHERE charge_point = '$chargepoint' AND transaction_id = $session AND measurand = 'SoC' AND location <> 'Body'

panels.title: Fully charged?
panels.description: Yes when the car's last reported SoC ≥ 99%; otherwise shows the SoC it reached. Empty ⇒ the firmware sent no EV SoC, so the question can't be answered from meter data.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN last(value, ts) >= 99 THEN 'Yes - ended at ' || round(last(value, ts))::int || '%' ELSE 'No - reached ' || round(last(value, ts))::int || '%' END AS "fully charged" FROM meter_samples WHERE charge_point = '$chargepoint' AND transaction_id = $session AND measurand = 'SoC' AND location <> 'Body'

panels.title: Session end
panels.description: Taper heuristic: if the average Power.Active.Import over the final 2 minutes is below 10% of the session peak, the car tapered off — the normal full-battery finish. Otherwise the session ended while still drawing hard: cable pulled or stop pressed before the car was done. Heuristic only, but a DC session ending at high power is a strong 'left early' signal (tx 100 ended at ~87 kW of a 119.9 kW peak).

targets.rawSql: WITH p AS (SELECT ts, value * CASE WHEN unit = 'kW' THEN 1 WHEN unit = 'MW' THEN 1000 ELSE 0.001 END AS kw FROM meter_samples WHERE charge_point = '$chargepoint' AND transaction_id = $session AND measurand = 'Power.Active.Import') SELECT CASE WHEN count(*) = 0 THEN NULL WHEN avg(kw) FILTER (WHERE ts >= (SELECT max(ts) FROM p) - interval '2 minutes') < 0.10 * max(kw) THEN 'Tapered - charge completed' ELSE 'Abrupt stop - unplugged early?' END AS "session end" FROM p

panels.title: Power — drawn vs offered
panels.description: Power.Active.Import (what the car actually drew) against Power.Offered (the charger's ceiling, dashed). The gap is what the session could have gone at: drawn < offered ⇒ the car is the limiter (battery management, temperature, taper). tx 100: 150 kW offered, 119.9 kW peak drawn — car-limited throughout. Plotted in absolute time; widen the range if empty.

defaults.noValue: No power samples for this session

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS "time", CASE measurand WHEN 'Power.Active.Import' THEN 'Drawn (Power.Active.Import)' ELSE 'Offered (Power.Offered)' END AS metric, value * CASE WHEN unit = 'kW' THEN 1 WHEN unit = 'MW' THEN 1000 ELSE 0.001 END AS value FROM meter_samples WHERE charge_point = '$chargepoint' AND transaction_id = $session AND measurand IN ('Power.Active.Import', 'Power.Offered') ORDER BY ts

panels.title: EV state of charge
panels.description: The car's SoC as reported by the charger (location = 'EV' on this firmware; the charger's own buffer battery, location = 'Body', is excluded — see the buffer panel above). The zeros at session start are the charger reporting before the car had announced its SoC. If this panel is empty for a session, the firmware didn't send EV SoC.

defaults.noValue: No SoC for this session — firmware didn't send it

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS "time", 'EV SoC' AS metric, value FROM meter_samples WHERE charge_point = '$chargepoint' AND transaction_id = $session AND measurand = 'SoC' AND location <> 'Body' ORDER BY ts

panels.title: Energy delivered this session
panels.description: Cumulative energy since session start: the import register minus its first in-session reading, so the curve runs 0 → session total (tx 100: 0 → 15.36 kWh). Never the absolute register — that's a lifetime meter (~1.14 MWh on this charger).

defaults.noValue: No import-register samples for this session

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS "time", 'Energy delivered' AS metric, value * CASE WHEN unit = 'kWh' THEN 1 WHEN unit = 'MWh' THEN 1000 ELSE 0.001 END - first_value(value * CASE WHEN unit = 'kWh' THEN 1 WHEN unit = 'MWh' THEN 1000 ELSE 0.001 END) OVER (ORDER BY ts) AS value FROM meter_samples WHERE charge_point = '$chargepoint' AND transaction_id = $session AND measurand = 'Energy.Active.Import.Register' ORDER BY ts
